title: Permutative Preference Alignment from Listwise Ranking of Human Judgments

live_model.evidence: "we employ GPT-4 Turbo (Achiam et al., 2023) as the standard judge model to determine which of..."; Table 7/8: GPT Judge = GPT-4-Turbo.

prompt.note: AlpacaEval/MT-Bench judge templates are external (alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo_fn); not printed in this paper.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4 Turbo itself (it judges win-rates of the trained policy/reward models, e.g. ArmoRM, Proxy models)

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is used only as the AlpacaEval/MT-Bench automatic judge scoring the paper's trained reward/policy models; no reported number is an output of GPT-4 Turbo performing the task itself.
